items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: He used to be Captain Hunter Satchel, man. He's got a payroll for Captain Hunter in the 50th.

ctx.x: I don't know the bass drum player. It's familiar, though. He died, man.
He died. He used to be Captain Hunter Satchel, man. He's got a payroll for Captain Hunter in the 50th.
Who's this? He was a bag man, huh? Yeah. I don't know what you mean by that, so I won't ask you any questions. Right? Yeah, he died. A natural death? A natural death.
